description: Fuelled by a powerful 680 mAh battery, boAt Storm Infinity Plus gives you 20 days of heavy use or 30 days of typical usage—no daily top-ups needed. And with ASAP™ Charge, it powers up to 100% in just 60 minutes, so you're always ready to go without long wait times. Stay connected and in control with the 1.96” (4.97 cm) display, offering vibrant 240x296 HD resolution and 500 nits brightness for clear visibility, even outdoors. Thanks to the Wake Gesture, you can check updates, notifications, or the time instantly—just raise your wrist. Comfort meets durability with the new nylon strap, designed for all-day wear whether you're hustling at work or sweating it out at the gym. It's breathable, comfy, and built to match your lifestyle. The smart functional crown lets you scroll, adjust, and control your watch effortlessly—even when your fingers are sweaty or gloved up during workouts. No worries about splashes, sweat, or dust—the IP68 rating ensures your smartwatch is as tough as your routine. Answer or reject calls, view messages, and get instant app notifications with Bluetooth Calling. Save contacts and stay in touch without pulling out your phone. Track your well-being round the clock with heart rate, SpO2 and sleep quality. With steps, calorie tracking and distance logs, it’s designed to support your personal health goals. Whether it’s outdoor cycling, jump rope, football, badminton, or yoga—choose from a wide range of sports modes to track every move with accuracy. Use smart utilities like hydration reminders, alarms, music and camera control, and Find My Phone. And in case of emergencies, a long press on the power button activates SOS alerts to your saved contact. Storm Infinity Plus is made for the ones who vibe different, hustle harder, and stay plugged in. If you're a boAthead, you already know—Wear Your Smart!
